faq.q: Is it a good spot to work or meet?
faq.a: Absolutely. A relaxed room that works for solo laptop sessions, friends and groups alike.
Many. Most breakfast, salad, pasta, bakery and pizza items have plant-based versions. Ask the waiter — we'll point them out.
Free fast WiFi. Outlets at most tables. It's a popular spot for laptops — especially weekday mornings.
Free parking on-site. Motorbikes and cars.
Outdoor seating is pet-friendly. Water bowls available.
Walk-ins always welcome. For groups of 4+ or a specific time slot, WhatsApp the manager. We hold tables for 15 minutes.
GoFood, GrabFood, or directly via signa.dishi.rest. In-house ordering is the fastest.
Pizza opens at 14:00 — the oven needs the morning to come up to temperature. Everything else is all day, 08:00–23:00.
